partner_json_extract.hero: Bolt × Navier — the European demand platform, now on the water
partner_json_extract.why_now: Bolt's strongest seasonal demand peaks are in markets where roads run out and the water begins, on ferry fleets that are among Europe's oldest and most polluting — exactly as the EU and Gulf tighten marine emissions and a ~100-vessel Navier network ramps in the Maldives. The in-app water tier is open across the entire Bolt footprint, for now.
partner_json_extract.network_thesis: One app. Every coastline. From the Aegean to the Gulf. | Bolt's busiest seasonal demand — the Cyclades, Dalmatia, Amalfi, the Riviera, the Gulf — sits exactly where the road network ends. Each of those markets is a dense water demand graph Bolt already owns on land. Navier supplies a uniform, software-defined, autonomy-ready fleet that books beside a Bolt car at every marina, identical from Athens to Dubai. Pick one market or commit to the network — the supply standard does not change.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Bolt already runs demand, dispatch, pricing and the app. A foiling water tier slots in as a premium mode — the water leg booked door-to-door with a Bolt car at each end, on the same app riders already use.
partner_json_extract.differentiation: {'why_navier': 'A uniform, software-defined, autonomy-ready foiling supply standard that drops in beside Bolt demand identically across every market — backed by an at-scale operating network in the Maldives and a Turkey factory for European and Gulf supply.'}
partner_json_extract.the_ask: {'navier_brings': 'The software-defined foiling fleet, captain training, the maintenance and certification path, and the network playbook proven in the Maldives — identical across every market.', 'partner_brings': 'In-market demand, dispatch and pricing through the Bolt app, plus local marina and operating relationships.', 'next_step': 'Pick a beachhead market — Greece is the recommended entry — and sign a pilot MOU on three corridors.'}
partner_json_extract.close: From the Aegean to the Gulf, in one app. | Bolt owns the demand across Europe's and the Gulf's most water-bound markets. Navier supplies the one surface no ride-hail player has claimed. Start with the Greek islands, or commit to the network.

Italy — Amalfi, Capri & the Venice lagoon
Saudi Arabia — Jeddah & the Red Sea
